  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <script>
    tailwind.config = {
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            optisol: {
              navy: '#0a2f5c',
              gold: '#f5b400',
              dark: '#051329',
              slate: '#f4f6f9',
              lightnavy: 'rgba(10, 47, 92, 0.05)',
              glass: 'rgba(5, 19, 41, 0.75)'
            }
          },
          animation: {
            'fade-in': 'fadeIn 0.35s ease-out forwards',
            'scale-up': 'scaleUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275) forwards',
            'draw-check': 'drawCheck 0.5s ease-in-out 0.15s forwards'
          },
          keyframes: {
            fadeIn: {
              '0%': { opacity: '0', transform: 'translateY(12px)' },
              '100%': { opacity: '1', transform: 'translateY(0)' }
            },
            scaleUp: {
              '0%': { opacity: '0', transform: 'scale(0.93)' },
              '100%': { opacity: '1', transform: 'scale(1)' }
            },
            drawCheck: {
              '100%': { strokeDashoffset: '0' }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  </script>

  <style>
  .glass-header {
      background: rgba(10, 47, 92, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 180, 0, 0.2);
    }
  .glass-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid rgba(10, 47, 92, 0.08);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(10, 47, 92, 0.05);
    }
  .glass-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(10, 47, 92, 0.25);

      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    details summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    details summary { list-style: none; }
  .faq-wrapper {
      max-height: 0;

    }
    details[open] + .faq-wrapper {
      max-height: 400px;

      transition: max-height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.85, 0, 0.15, 1), opacity 0.3s ease-in;
    }
  .checkmark-stroke { stroke-dasharray: 100; stroke-dashoffset: 100; }
  .product-tile { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  .product-tile::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55), transparent 55%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
    }
    /* Touch-friendly tap targets on small screens */
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .filter-btn { padding-top: 0.7rem; padding-bottom: 0.7rem; }
      a, button { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(245,180,0,0.25); }
    }
  </style>
</head>
